purpose: Evidence registry for public language-in-motion examples. Unverified means no claim of executable compiler support.

examples.syntax_delta: Java feature-branch fixture uses non-generic ActorStream plus closed ActorMail<PipeMessages>; marketing site shows proposed ActorStream<int> with empty actors.
examples.capability_constraints: exactly three exclusive actor instances; bounded single-flow roundtrip; full-route physical completion

promotion_rules: Never use the word verified for a backend until its exact candidate Git commit compiled and ran the pinned fixture in a job with executed steps.
Do not infer production main support from a draft PR or a feature branch.
Do not infer source conformance from the marketing-site HTML, syntax highlighting, unit tests or browser CI.
Update source blob SHA and expected output when the fixture changes; invalidate prior evidence.
Never copy private compiler source across repositories without protected-branch approval of an exact private destination.
